parsed.summary: The build's wiring, parts, values and power architecture match the specification: dual MCU (STM32H753VITx FCC / STM32F405RGTx NAVC), MIC26903YJL-TR buck with 15uH L and ~5V divider (R51 6k8 / R62 1k3), LD39200PU33R 3V3 LDO, 10 mΩ shunt sensed by INA219AIDCNR, and the BMI088/IIS2MDCTR/MPRLS/TMP100/MAX-8Q/PCA9685PW/W25N01/24CW1280 peripheral set with consistent I2C addressing. The only textual discrepancies I found are the documented barometer RESET/EOC pin swap (explicitly a known bug, not an anomaly) and the PCA9685 I2C-address note (0x41 in the drawing vs 0x40 in the spec table); the 0x41 strapping is the only electrically sane choice because the PCA9685 shares net NET0048/NET0088 with the INA219 at 0x40, so this is a spec-table transcription inconsistency rather than a behavioural deviation. I did not find a wiring-supported deviation that would change board behaviour.
